description: Given a Prefect @task that uses tableau-server-client (TSC) to refresh a Tableau workbook or datasource extract, convert it to an Orchestra pipeline YAML task under the TABLEAU_CLOUD integration with the correct integration_job (TABLEAU_REFRESH_WORKBOOK vs. TABLEAU_REFRESH_EXTRACT), the required project_name parameter, and credentials represented via a connection: field rather than inline env vars.

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect task to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/workbook_refresh_task.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live refresh, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single TABLEAU_CLOUD task using integration_job TABLEAU_REFRESH_WORKBOOK, with parameters.project_name 'Sales' and parameters.workbook_name 'Sales Dashboard', connection: referencing an Orchestra Tableau Cloud connection rather than the raw TABLEAU_TOKEN_NAME/TABLEAU_TOKEN env vars, and no site_id/site_name parameter on the task (it lives on the connection).

assertions.text: parameters.project_name ('Sales') is present — REQUIRED alongside workbook_name per the skill's Gotchas, not omitted or left for the connection to imply
TABLEAU_TOKEN_NAME / TABLEAU_TOKEN env var values are not written as literal parameter values in the YAML — they're represented by a connection: reference
site_id ('salesteam') is not duplicated as a task parameter since it belongs on the Orchestra connection

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect task to an Orchestra pipeline task, noting it refreshes a Tableau datasource extract, not a workbook (see files/datasource_extract_refresh_task.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live refresh, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single TABLEAU_CLOUD task using integration_job TABLEAU_REFRESH_EXTRACT, with parameters.project_name 'Finance' and parameters.datasource_name 'Finance Extract', connection: referencing an Orchestra Tableau Cloud connection holding the PAT rather than TABLEAU_PAT_NAME/TABLEAU_PAT_SECRET literal values, and no invented workbook_name field.

assertions.text: parameters.project_name ('Finance') is present — REQUIRED alongside datasource_name per the skill's Gotchas
The task's parameters do not invent a workbook_name field — this is an extract/datasource refresh, so only project_name and datasource_name are set
No literal PAT name/secret values (TABLEAU_PAT_NAME/TABLEAU_PAT_SECRET) are written into the YAML — the personal access token is represented via a connection: field
